title: regression in keymap generation

labels.name: engine
labels.description: engines, connections, transactions, isolation levels, execution options

body:
likely due to recent commits.  in this case, both the contents of "_keymap" as well as what _ColumnEntity are doing are different, may be two separate issues.

```
import datetime

from sqlalchemy import case
from sqlalchemy import Column
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy import Date
from sqlalchemy import DateTime
from sqlalchemy import Integer
from sqlalchemy.ext.compiler import compiles
from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from sqlalchemy.sql import expression
from sqlalchemy import select


class add_months(expression.FunctionElement):
    """function to add `n` months to a date.

    Implemented for oracle and sqlite.
    """

    type = Date()
    name = "add_months"


@compiles(add_months)
def add_months_default(element, compiler, **kw):
    return compiler.visit_function(element)


@compiles(add_months, "oracle")
def add_months_oracle(element, compiler, **kw):
    # oracle implementation of "add_months"
    (date, number) = list(element.clauses)
    return "ADD_MONTHS(%s, %s)" % (
        compiler.process(date),
        compiler.process(number),
    )


class month(expression.FunctionElement):
    """function returns first of month of given date.

    Implemented for oracle and sqlite.
    """

    type = Date()
    name = "month"


@compiles(month)
def month_default(element, compiler, **kw):
    return compiler.visit_function(element)


@compiles(month, "oracle")
def month_oracle(element, compiler, **kw):
    # oracle implementation of `month`
    (arg,) = list(element.clauses)
    return "TRUNC(%s, 'MONTH')" % (compiler.process(arg),)


Base = declarative_base()


class A(Base):
    __tablename__ = "a"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    date = Column(DateTime)


e = create_engine("oracle://scott:tiger@oracle1120", echo=True)
Base.metadata.drop_all(e)
Base.metadata.create_all(e)

s = Session(e)

s.add(A(id=1, date=datetime.datetime(2019, 10, 5, 12, 47, 18)))
s.commit()

col = month(case([(A.id == 1, datetime.datetime(2019, 10, 5, 12, 47, 18))]))

#stmt = select([col])
#result = s.execute(stmt)
#row = result.fetchone()
#print(row[col])

s.query(col).all()

```
